title: Clean Sheet
text: Finish a mission with no mistakes, no help, and no recovery.

title: Steady Hands
text: Recover from an emergency without help.
hint: Fix it yourself after a problem.

title: Classified
text: Log the strange signal as unknown and keep to the facts.

title: Verified
hint: Check the helper before you trust it.

title: First Contact
text: Follow protocol when the signal is heard.
